1933, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 155 Cont.
Oct. 22 Dennis Hills - 10 - To-morrow - doctoring nearly 2 yrs. ??? Diabe- tis, Jandis, terrible headaches ... if not better soon - must go to hospital for special examin ..... Enrolled perpetually 6 yrs. ago. To-day again for $1.00 - paralysis feared - cannot walk.
Arthur Rousso - 45 - Chicago - something like stroke over year .? Drs. doubting . Enrolled for yr. To-day. ..
25th Rev. Martin Gallagher - 35 - cancer feard on knee. Enrolled To-day. 1933, November
Page 156
Nov. 1st. Frank Savanne - 48 - blind - got piece of steel in eye 2'2 yrs. ago. Nellie & Richard O'Brien - 9 & 7 - of Windsor - T.B. of bone ... Dan . Azelio - 27 - "Miraculous escape " thrown forty feet head- long and thru passage meant to admit a person side-wise .... a Cath- olic - had been married before a justice of peace. This happened on 9th day after his marriage. His friend J. Coneff had refused to be "witness" at marriage ...
Mrs. Anna Macey - 58 - diabetis - South of St. Louis - non C. - losing sight.
Mrs. Olive Desmier - 40 - cancer of cervex - 2 children.
Mrs. Spoorer - 50 - choaking improving - new pain in side .....
Theresa Drqewicki - 31 - Ep. Fits 23 yrs. - has position in hosp- ital (Harper) laundry - 1800 sheets per day .. ... Mother Catherina ( Felic'an) hard of hearing. Page 157 Nov. 1 D.M. and L.H. Dandero - wayward careless in practice of religion. ... Mrs. J. Lang - 44 - tumors .. .
Mrs. Mary Johnson - 68 - fell on icy stairs last winter .... now caus- ing trouble in back & feet.
Wm. Bergeon - 35 - operated for Eyes - now double vision.
Delia Nagorsen - 46 - fell on ice and hurt spine.
